subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

In spring the leaves are __bright__ green, whereas they appear ______ in autumn.
solution:
The correct answer is** ****Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**bright**' means having a lot of light; (used about a colour) strong and easy to see.(चमकदार)

 
 
• **Example **- The day was **bright **and sunny.
 
 
 
• **'Dull' **means not interesting or exciting; boring.(उदासीन)
 
 
• **Example **- The color of the walls was **dull **and lifeless.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of '**Bright**' is '**Dull**'.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is **'Dull'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meaning and example sentences:

 
• **Gleaming **(चमचमाती) - Appearing to give off light or brightness; radiant; shining brightly.

 
 
• **Example **- The kitchen is very modern, with **gleaming **stainless steel surfaces.
 
 
 
• **Dazzling **(बहुत चमकीला) - Extremely bright or impressive.
 
 
• **Example **- The match showed off his **dazzling **skills as a footballer.
 
 
 
• **Luminous **(चमकदार) - Radiating or reflecting light; that shines in the dark.
 
 
• **Example **- Our theory might predict that the most massive galaxies are the most **luminous**.
 
 

41:Td02,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**
